case_name: NOIDA Entrepreneurs' Association v New Okhla Industrial Development Authority and others
holding: The arbitrary character of the action taken by NOIDA is demonstrated by the fact that even though Mr. Rajiv Kumar did not want alternative plot, NOIDA has offered him alternative plot.
Notices are issued to all the persons named in paragraph 16 to show cause as to why allotments/alternative allotments made in their favour may not be quashed.
cases_cited: NOIDA Entrepreneurs' Association v New Okhla Industrial Development Authority
